name: Lambrusco di Sorbara

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

terms: Denominazione di Origine Controllata. The label names a precise area, and the wine is tested during production.

blurb.text: An Emilia-Romagna DOC for sparkling and semi-sparkling red and rosé wine, with a white sparkling version too. Its vineyards must be at least 60% Lambrusco di Sorbara. Lambrusco Salamino and other Lambrusco grapes may make up the rest, within set limits.
